title: Ready. Set. BLINK! Opening Ceremony
time_text: Thursday, October 8, 2026, from 4:00–9:00 p.m.
room: Central Parkway between Liberty Street and West 14th Street
description: New for 2026, the Ready. Set. BLINK! Opening Ceremony will offer a more immersive opening celebration that brings the community together. Featuring luminous interactive installations, electrifying live performances, hands-on creative experiences, and opportunities to create and wear your own light art, Ready, Set, BLINK! serves as the spark that ignites BLINK’s four-day celebration of art, creativity, technology, and community.
notes: Replaces the former opening parade. ICS: DTSTART 20261008T160000, DTEND 20261008T210000 America/New_York. Schedule per the page FAQ: begins 4:00 p.m. with live music from local DJs and national performers, interactive installations, light-art creation stations and food trucks. Performers not yet named.

title: BLINK: Run the Night
time_text: Tue, October 6, 2026 7:30 PM EDT
room: Start and finish: Elm Street Plaza
description:
Join Pig Works and BLINK, Illuminated by ArtsWave, for a one-of-a-kind nighttime run through downtown Cincinnati. This exclusive Tuesday evening event gives participants early access to select BLINK installations, transforming your run into an immersive journey through light, art, music, and creativity.

Starting at Elm Street Plaza, you'll follow a unique 2.6-mile route, experiencing the magic and wonder of BLINK before the crowds arrive. This is not your typical race… it is a chance to move through the city, take in the art, and experience the energy of BLINK in a way few people ever will.

The course route and featured installations will be revealed soon.
notes: Linked from the BLINK Event Guide ("Run The Night"). Organized by Pig Works (Flying Pig Marathon): untimed 2.6-mile night run with early access to select BLINK installations; route not yet revealed.

title: 0H10M1ke Light Installation
time_text: Listed under "Friday, October 09, 2026" in the Art and Artists date filter; no time given
description: 0H10M1ke is a Brooklyn-based interdisciplinary artist known as “The One-Line Master,” recognized for creating more than 15,000 live portraits and light-based performances across cities including New York, Miami, Tokyo, Kyoto, and Berlin. Working at the intersection of drawing, performance, and light, he translates real-time gesture into luminous forms using a Wacom tablet and stylus, treating each mark as an immediate, unrepeatable response to the moment. His ongoing series L1ght Graff1t1 Make0vers transforms participants into vivid, reimagined identities through live digital light performance, blending street aesthetics, improvisation, and spectacle. Across international exhibitions at venues such as the Park Avenue Armory, the Guggenheim Museum, and the Museum of Graffiti, his work explores light as both medium and metaphor for connection, impermanence, and shared human presence.
notes: The only Art and Artists entry with a date. No time or exact spot published; zone from the listing filter (The Banks).

title: Fall Cov Craft-Covington's Curated Makers Market
time_text: Saturday, October 10 from 10 a.m.-4 p.m.
description: Join the fun Saturday, October 10 from 10 a.m.-4 p.m. at Fall Cov Craft-Covington's Curated Makers Market! Hosted by Handzy Shop + Studio and sponsored by BLINK Cincinnati, the market celebrates creativity, community, and local love. Shop a curated lineup of makers and artists, sip on beer from West Sixth Brewing, and enjoy local food. The market takes place on the Sixth Street Promenade in the MainStrasse Village neighborhood of Covington, KY.
notes: Hosted by Handzy Shop + Studio and sponsored by BLINK Cincinnati (listed on BLINK Around Town under the heading "Cov Craft Fair"; title as written in the listing text).

title: Harper Alive at The Mercantile Immersive
time_text: October 9th starting at 6:00 PM. Show up anytime within the hours listed on your ticket during BLINK 2026
description:
Created exclusively for Mercantile Immersive, Harper Alive transforms the Harpers’ iconic artwork into a breathtaking 360-degree journey of movement, light, music, and storytelling. Wander through vibrant forests, soar alongside birds, encounter playful wildlife, and explore bold geometric landscapes as their celebrated “minimal realism” comes alive all around you.

Your experience begins in the Oculus Gallery, where historical photographs, archival footage, and personal stories reveal the remarkable lives and artistic partnership of Charley and Edie Harper. Then, step into the Vista Room, where floor-to-ceiling LED displays, spatial audio, dynamic lighting, and an original musical score surround you in an unforgettable six-minute immersive experience.

Whether you’re a lifelong Harper admirer or discovering their work for the first time, Harper Alive offers a completely new way to experience two of Cincinnati’s most beloved artists.
notes: Listed on BLINK Around Town; not produced by BLINK. Ticketed (Humanitix).

title: Turn The Lights On Coloring Contest
time_text: The Contest begins on August 31, 2026 at 9:00 a.m. Eastern Time and ends on September 25, 2026 at 5:00 p.m. Eastern Time.
description: The Turn the Lights On Contest, brought to you by First Financial Bank, brings the spirit of BLINK 2026 into communities across the region, inviting kids 12 and under to get creative and celebrate innovation, connection and imagination. One grand prize winner will have the unforgettable opportunity to “Turn the Lights On” and officially kick off BLINK 2026 at the first-ever Ready. Set. BLINK! Opening Ceremony.
notes: Presented by First Financial Bank. Open to kids 12 and under; entries are submitted in person at a participating First Financial Banking Center by 5:00 p.m. ET on September 25, 2026. The winner is notified by October 1, 2026 and gets to "Turn the Lights On" at the Ready. Set. BLINK! Opening Ceremony on October 8 (see blink-2026-10-08-flip-the-switch). Contest period, not a visitor event.
